styles.title: I start with characters
styles.description: You picture a Sim first: who they are, what they love, what drives them crazy. The story grows out of them.
styles.yapPrompt: Tell us about your Sim (or Sims). Who are they? What are they like? What do they want?

styles.title: I start with a plot
styles.description: You have a situation or a 'what if' in mind, and you'll make the Sims to fit it.
styles.yapPrompt: What's the situation? What happens, or what could happen?

styles.title: I just have a vibe
styles.description: Nothing specific yet, just a feeling, a mood, or an aesthetic you want to play in.
styles.yapPrompt: Describe the mood. Words, colors, songs, seasons, anything that captures it.

styles.title: I want to recreate a movie, show, or book
styles.description: Bring a story you love into the game, as close to the original or as loose as you like.
styles.yapPrompt: Which story? Who are the characters you want to play, and how close to the original should it stay?

styles.title: I'm building around a theme or pack
styles.description: You want to play with a specific pack, life state, or theme, like vampires, a farm, or university life.
styles.yapPrompt: What theme or pack do you want to play with? What about it excites you?

styles.title: I'm not sure / something else
styles.description: No idea yet, or you start some other way. That's fine. We'll help you find a starting point.
styles.yapPrompt: Anything at all: a Sim you liked, a show you're watching, something that happened today. Even a few words is plenty.
